notes.title: Demo Update, Kickstarter, and Creature Collector Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm so happy to announce that Synth Beasts part of [b]Steam's Creature Collector Fest[/b]! We have a free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421080/Synth_Beasts/]1h-long demo featured on the store page[/url], and we just pushed update 0.5.0 so it's better than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/8e664978f79850cc98844841c22d3d742e6df6db.png[/img]

If this is your first time coming across Synth Beasts, I'd also like to let you know that its [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]Kickstarter campaign is running right now[/url]! We're 149% funded, but would still [b]love your help to reach the stretch goals[/b]! Keys are available for Steam, Switch 1, Switch 2, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S, so [b]all major platforms are covered[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/a9d90265ec048e033411f6a3be1e9f0611bbe2db.png[/img]

Anyways, that's it for this update! I hope you enjoy the demo, and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]please consider backing Synth Beasts on Kickstarter[/url] if you enjoyed it!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Demo OUT NOW + Crowdfunding RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

4 months ago I announced that Synth Beasts would be coming to Kickstarter, and... I'm excited to announce that it has [b]JUST LAUNCHED[/b]! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]Check out the campaign here[/url].

It's a [b]Monster Taming Action RPG[/b], so think [b]Pokemon with real-time combat[/b] and a Metroidvania-inspired open world. [b]It's also got a free demo here on Steam[/b], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421080/Synth_Beasts/]so go check it out on the store page[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/5d3e6a969ff277ac8707992a0eac547c08270c9f.png[/img]

There are [b]2 main reasons [/b]I decided to bring Synth Beasts to Kickstarter:

[list]
[*] Firstly, while the game's core development is almost done, I want to bring it to [b]as many platforms as possible[/b]. With Soul Stalker, we initially planned to only bring it to Steam and Switch, but [b]because of our awesome porting partners at Origami Panda Studio[/b], we were also able to bring it to Xbox and PlayStation! Now that we have experience doing all of this, I wanted to continue doing so with Synth Beasts, and [b]the Kickstarter make this possible[/b]!
[*] Secondly, [b]I absolutely loved involving the community[/b] in our previous games' development. Some of the best items, characters, and monsters were all designed by you guys through the creative backer tiers, and [b]Synth Beasts is doubling down[/b] on that.

[/list]

Some of Synth Beasts' creative tiers include:

[list]
[*] [b]Design a Boss ➜ [/b]Create its look, mechanics, and backstory.
[*] [b]Build an Island ➜[/b] Craft a whole explorable area with lore, puzzles, and combat.
[*] [b]Create a Synth Beast ➜[/b] Bring your own playable monster to life.
[*] [b]Make a Gizmo ➜[/b] Invent an equippable item that alters creature abilities, inspired by Hollow Knight’s Charm system.
[*] [b]Build a Statue ➜[/b] Immortalise yourself on the Hero’s Isle with custom visuals and an inscription.
[*] [b]Form an NPC ➜[/b] Bring yourself to life as one of the game's scientists! You get to decide what the NPC says!
[*] [b]Message in a Bottle ➜[/b] Leave riddles, secrets, or heartfelt notes for players to discover.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/2bae74242d2d6c1a353fa5e0e8eb485066adffc5.gif[/img]

If Synth Beasts sounds like your kind of game, make sure to back it here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-tamin]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-tamin[/url]g ! 

Anyways, that's it for this update, and see you soon :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer
